cards.p: Before you write anything, ask me 5 questions about my [business] so your answers fit me.
Fix the spelling and tone of this customer message. Keep my words where you can: [paste].
This email is too long: [paste]. Cut it to 3 sentences and keep the one thing they must do.
Read your last answer again. What could be wrong or missing for a [business] like mine? Fix it.
Sort these [month] receipts into categories that fit a [business]. Total each. Table, biggest first: [paste].
I attached a photo of a receipt. Pull out date, store, total and tax as one table row.
Compare my bank lines [paste] with my receipt list [paste]. Which charges have no receipt yet?
Here are 3 months of my business costs: [paste]. Which ones went up, and by how much?
Write a friendly first reminder for invoice [number], [amount], due [date]. Assume they forgot. Pay link [link].
Two reminders about [amount] got no reply. Write a calm final notice with a clear pay by date [date].
A client cannot pay [amount] at once. Offer a 3 part payment plan with dates. Kind and short.
Here are my open invoices: [paste]. Sort them by days late and tell me who to chase today.
I am upset about this review: [paste]. First tell me what is fair in it, then write a calm reply.
I cannot find this reviewer in my records: [paste]. Write a short, polite public reply asking them to call me.
Turn this kind review into a short thank you text I can send the customer myself: [paste].
Reply to this review in the language it was written in, then show me the English: [paste].
Look at the photo I attached. Write 7 captions for next week, each opening with a different hook.
Customers keep asking me [question]. Turn my answer into a short post with one tip at the end.
Here are 3 posts I wrote: [paste]. Describe my voice, then write my next post about [topic].
Write 5 short posts about a normal day at my [business], from opening to closing. One line each.
Someone texted only 'how much?'. Reply with my range [range] and one question so I can price it.
A customer wants a discount on [service]. Say no kindly and offer [small extra] instead. Under 40 words.
Write an auto reply for texts after [time]: we got it, when we reply, and my price page [link].
Turn my price list into a short text I can paste when asked. Plain words, no table: [paste].
